assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Higgs boson’s discovery completed a central part of the Standard Model and was a defining experimental achievement in particle physics.
assessment.attribution: The work depended on two large collaborations; these leaders represent major experimental and organizational contributions, though credit cannot be cleanly reduced to a few people.
assessment.maturity: The signal has been confirmed and studied across many channels for more than a decade.
uncertainties: Selecting a small number of representatives from ATLAS and CMS necessarily leaves out many essential contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Precision maps of cosmic microwave background anisotropies turned cosmology into a precision science and constrained the universe’s composition and history.
assessment.attribution: These names span mission leadership and influential analysis and interpretation; the achievement was collective, with substantial contributions from instrument and survey teams.
assessment.maturity: Independent measurements and later observations have reinforced the cosmological picture built from these maps.
uncertainties: Credit overlaps with earlier CMB discoveries and with later experiments that refined the measurements.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube established high-energy neutrinos as a new astronomical messenger, opening a window on the most energetic processes in the universe.
assessment.attribution: The named leaders were central to conceiving, building, and realizing the observatory; the discovery and detector work were substantially collaborative.
assessment.maturity: The astrophysical flux is well established, although identifying its sources remains an active area of research.
uncertainties: The connection between the detected neutrinos and particular source populations is still incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Horizon-scale imaging of black holes provided a striking new test of strong-gravity predictions and a major advance in radio interferometry.
assessment.attribution: The credited names represent important conceptual, observational, and technical leadership, but the images were the work of a very large international collaboration.
assessment.maturity: The first images have been supported by further observations and independent analysis, while the method continues to improve.
uncertainties: The division of credit among the many people who developed the array, calibration, and imaging methods is difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Numerical relativity made realistic predictions for binary black-hole mergers possible and helped turn gravitational-wave astronomy into a practical science.
assessment.attribution: These researchers made seminal, complementary advances in solving the merger problem; many further groups developed and applied the methods.
assessment.maturity: The methods have been validated through successful waveform modeling and repeated gravitational-wave observations.
uncertainties: The discovery of gravitational waves and the numerical methods that enabled their interpretation are closely connected but distinct contributions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks transformed precision timekeeping and enable tests of fundamental physics as well as practical applications.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye independently pioneered complementary approaches that established the field.
assessment.maturity: The clocks are highly developed and their precision and stability have been demonstrated across multiple systems.
uncertainties: The most consequential long-term scientific and practical applications are still emerging.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and the quantum origin of primordial structure offer a powerful account of the early universe and connect quantum physics to cosmic observations.
assessment.attribution: Guth and Linde developed influential inflationary ideas, while Mukhanov made foundational contributions to the generation and prediction of primordial perturbations.
assessment.maturity: The framework has substantial indirect observational support, but inflation itself and the detailed mechanism remain unsettled.
uncertainties: There is no unique confirmed inflationary model, and primordial gravitational waves have not been detected.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rydberg blockade and programmable neutral-atom arrays provide a powerful platform for quantum simulation and controllable many-body experiments.
assessment.attribution: The credited researchers made important complementary contributions to the physical mechanism and its use in scalable arrays.
assessment.maturity: The platform has advanced rapidly, with convincing demonstrations, but its broader scientific and computational impact is still developing.
uncertainties: It remains unclear which discoveries enabled by these arrays will prove most fundamental.
